records.issue_text: [High/bug] EventManager.ts (update, ~line 510-545) — credential declared outside the loop is reused across iterations; if a reference's credential lookup fails, a stale credential from a previous iteration is passed to updateEvent, updating the wrong calendar
records.rationale: The diff declares `credential` once outside the loop (`let calendarReference ... , credential;` in EventManager's update). Inside the per-reference loop, `credential = this.calendarCredentials.filter(...)[0]` may be undefined, then a DB fetch runs, but if the DB fetch also fails to produce a credential, the code still calls `updateEvent(credential, ...)` without a guard — reusing the previous iteration's credential (stale) or passing undefined. This can update the wrong calendar. The mechanism is directly visible in the new loop code.

records.rationale: The finding claims the diff 'dropped the user fallback entirely' in requestReschedule.handler.ts, but the removed line was `destinationCalendar: bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar || bookingToReschedule?.destinationCalendar` — the same expression twice, a tautology with no user.destinationCalendar fallback to begin with. The old code fell back to nothing; the new code wraps the same single value in an array. No fallback was dropped, and any inconsistency with other handlers predates this change.
